title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the historic wood-paneled reading rooms of Hubbard Hall to the modern, light-filled 'Lantern' at the Roux Center, Bowdoin offers a range of environments for deep focus and collaborative work.

cards.title: Pierce Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Hawthorne-Longfellow Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Find a seat in this traditional, quiet reading room. It is a central hub for focused individual study within the main library building.
cards.short_summary: A traditional quiet reading room located on the second floor of the Hawthorne-Longfellow Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pierce Reading Room is located on Level 2 of the Hawthorne-Longfellow Library and is a designated study area.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; Bowdoin ID required for entry after 5 PM.

cards.title: Hubbard Hall Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Hubbard Hall, Level 1
cards.notes: Study in the former Arctic Museum space, now a bright reading room with large windows and group-friendly tables.
cards.short_summary: A newly renovated reading room in Hubbard Hall featuring ample natural light and group study tables.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hubbard Hall Reading Room was created in the space formerly occupied by the Peary-MacMillan Arctic Museum and is available for student study.
cards.source_title: A New Chapter: Enter the Hubbard Hall Reading Room
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; features open tables and couches.

cards.title: The Lantern
cards.subtitle: Roux Center for the Environment
cards.notes: Utilize the tiered bench seating in this glass-walled auditorium for informal study with views of the campus pines.
cards.short_summary: A multi-story glass atrium in the Roux Center used for lectures and informal student study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lantern is a tiered, glassy space in the Roux Center used for informal gatherings and as a study area.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; features integrated bench seating.

cards.title: Abrahamson Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Hubbard Hall, Level 6
cards.notes: Climb to the top of Hubbard Hall for a quiet, secluded study environment away from the main campus traffic.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study area located on the sixth floor of Hubbard Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Abrahamson Reading Room is located on Level 6 of Hubbard Hall and is designated as a study area.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the Hubbard Hall stacks; check library hours for stack access.

cards.title: Hatch Science Library Seminar Rooms
cards.subtitle: Druckenmiller Hall
cards.notes: Book one of two mid-sized rooms equipped with whiteboards and technology for collaborative group projects.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms in the Hatch Science Library equipped with collaborative tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Hatch Science Library has two mid-sized group study rooms accommodating up to 8 people with whiteboards and projection capabilities.
cards.access_notes: Reservable online by students; available during Hatch Library hours.

cards.title: Gibson Salon
cards.subtitle: Gibson Hall
cards.notes: Study in a room featuring 18th-century French oak paneling and a marble fireplace for a sophisticated atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: An elegant student lounge in Gibson Hall known for its historic wood paneling and quiet atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gibson Salon, also known as the Gibson Lounge, features carved oak paneling and is a favorite place for students to study.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; located on the first floor of Gibson Hall.

cards.title: Beckwith Music Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Gibson Hall, Room 101
cards.notes: Use the technology-friendly furniture and listening stations in this specialized library for music-related or quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library reading room in Gibson Hall with listening equipment and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beckwith Music Library reading room includes technology-friendly furniture and space for group study.
cards.access_notes: Open to the Bowdoin community; check specific music library hours.

cards.title: Smith Union Lounge
cards.subtitle: David Saul Smith Union
cards.notes: Choose this spot for a more social study environment near the cafe and campus mail center.
cards.short_summary: A central, active study and meeting space located within the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Union serves as a primary study and meeting space for students and houses the cafe and Bowdoin Store.
cards.access_notes: Open late; typically accessible 24/7 with a Bowdoin ID.

cards.title: Edwards Center Gallery Corridors
cards.subtitle: Edwards Center for Art and Dance
cards.notes: Study surrounded by student art in the wide, bright corridors of this repurposed elementary school.
cards.short_summary: Bright, wide corridors in the Edwards Center that serve as both gallery space and informal study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Edwards Center's wide corridors are designed as gallery space and the building includes student exhibition space.
cards.source_title: Edwards Center: Adaptive Reuse at Bowdoin College
cards.access_notes: Building accessible to students; 24-hour key card access for art students.

cards.title: Media Commons Screening Rooms
cards.subtitle: Hawthorne-Longfellow Library, Basement
cards.notes: Reserve these specialized rooms for viewing media or working on digital projects in a controlled environment.
cards.short_summary: Specialized rooms in the library basement for media viewing and digital production work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Media Commons in the H-L Library basement offers reservable screening rooms and media production studios.
cards.access_notes: Reservable online; located in the basement of the main library.
